description: This file contains the CredentialProvider class in the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides various static methods to create credential provider functions that locate AWS credentials from different sources such as environment variables, ini files, ECS, STS, and SSO sessions. The class also supports chaining multiple providers, caching, and handling assume role scenarios.

classes.name: CredentialProvider
classes.description: A static class providing factory methods to create AWS credential provider functions from various sources and mechanisms, such as environment variables, ini files, ECS, STS, SSO, and chained providers.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default credential provider that checks environment variables, web identity, SSO credentials, ini files, ECS, or EC2 instance profile credentials, with caching support.

methods.name: fromCredentials
methods.description: Creates a credential provider function from a static CredentialsInterface object.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates an aggregate provider that invokes multiple provided credential provider functions until one returns credentials.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache its credentials and refresh them if expired.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a provider and caches credentials in the provided cache interface.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Provides credentials from environment variables AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.

methods.name: instanceProfile
methods.description: Provides EC2 instance profile credentials.

methods.name: sso
methods.description: Provides cached SSO credentials from the ~/.aws/sso directory.

methods.name: ecsCredentials
methods.description: Provides ECS container credentials.

methods.name: assumeRole
methods.description: Provides credentials by assuming an IAM role.

methods.name: assumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider
methods.description: Provides credentials by assuming a role with a web identity token.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Provides credentials from AWS CLI credentials or config ini files.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Provides credentials via an external process specified in the ini file.

methods.name: getCredentialsFromSource
methods.description: Retrieves credentials from the source specified in profile data.

methods.name: loadProfiles
methods.description: Loads profiles from a specified ini file, including optional merging of config files.

methods.name: loadDefaultProfiles
methods.description: Loads default profiles from ~/.aws/credentials and ~/.aws/config files.

methods.name: getSsoCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves SSO credentials, possibly involving token refresh.

methods.name: getSsoCredentialsLegacy
methods.description: Retrieves legacy SSO credentials from cached token files.

methods.name: getCredentialsFromSsoService
methods.description: Calls the AWS SSO service to obtain role credentials.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Gets the current user's home directory.

methods.name: loadRoleProfile
methods.description: Handles loading and assuming roles via specified profiles.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Determines the filename for credentials based on environment variables or default paths.

methods.name: shouldUseEcs
methods.description: Determines if ECS credentials should be used based on environment variables.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Creates a rejected Promise with a CredentialsException for error handling.
